data.text: Tap: disable every trap within 3 hexes that is not yours — each laid trap goes to its owner's discard pile; a building's or dungeon's trap is simply gone. Untap by emitting every colour. Passive: when you step onto a building with trap(s), they do not spring (no damage, nothing is cast on you) and their cards go to your discard pile.

ability.note: resolved in simulate() (map geometry, occupancy, the move register) — not separable without changing behaviour
